MGS Transport Services: Helping you deliver your chilled, frozen & ambient goods across the UK and Europe
Welcome to MGS Transport Services!
We are a London freight service, who have been specialising for the last 20 years in the delivery of frozen, chilled and ambient food products across the UK and Europe.
With long-term relationships with some of the largest food manufacturers and haulage companies across the country, we are a wholly professional team who are extremely passionate about taking care of all your transport requirements.
We're a well-established company with a great reputation.

MGS Transport Services: Helping you deliver your chilled, frozen & ambient goods across the UK and Europe
MGS Transport Services is a well-established family business which has a proud history of transporting goods throughout the UK and overseas. We have competitive rates, dedicated customer service and a superb record of meeting our customers' requirements.
We have been established for over 20 years specialising in frozen, chilled & ambient food transport throughout the UK and Europe within the food industry and major supermarkets.
Dealing with full and part pallet loads of temperature controlled goods.
We also have a ready supply of professional hauliers & temperature controlled vehicles to collect and transport your product to the necessary destinations across all of England, Scotland, Wales and Western Europe.
MGS Transport Services aims not only to serve our customers with commitment and professionalism but also to conduct our business so that we always come up to the standards that our customers have come to expect of us.
